extracted.intended_audience: general readers interested in U.S. defense policy and congressional hearings (AP news audience, policymakers, journalists)
extracted.subtask_description: An AP Foreign Service news article summarizing Senate subcommittee hearings and testimony about U.S. missile, bomber and space programs, including officials' recommendations and congressional queries about accelerating development and maintaining deterrence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand research
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand research, which he said is being done.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as the first of several concrete steps Senator Johnson elicited from the secretaries to speed missile development; framed as an ongoing activity needing continuation and expansion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerate and increase planned operational capacities of Atlas and Titan
rubrics_metrics.description: Accelerate and increase 'the planned operational capacities of Atlas and Titan,' by spending more money in both the 1958 and 1959 fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit recommendation to boost funding in upcoming budgets to move Atlas and Titan toward operational capacity sooner; tied to fiscal-year budgeting timelines (fiscal 1958 ends June 30).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool up early for production (accept reasonable risk)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool up for production early — taking a short-cut in tooling up (as with the Thor) was judged 'worth the risk' to create a production complex capable of early quantity production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argues for deliberate early investment in production tooling and capacity even at risk, to enable rapid quantity production when tests warrant; illustrated by the Thor decision and resulting production complex.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain current deterrent (SAC) while developing new weapons
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain the deterrent force with the weapons of today; give continued support to Strategic Air Command (SAC) and its present capabilities while new systems are developed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated emphasis by witnesses that while investing in missiles and space, the U.S. must not weaken present combat capability — avoid trading current readiness for future projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disperse SAC units to additional bases
rubrics_metrics.description: Take immediate steps for dispersal of Strategic Air Command (SAC) units to additional bases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as an urgent operational measure to reduce vulnerability and preserve deterrent capability in a crisis; part of readiness/risk mitigation while buildup continues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase funding for Thor and Atlas programs
rubrics_metrics.description: The Defense Department has approved more money for the Thor and Atlas; planners urged spending to speed development and production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding increases are recommended as necessary to accelerate operational readiness and production; tied to budget requests and appropriation cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and field simpler, solid‑propellant missiles for faster firing
rubrics_metrics.description: Smaller missiles using solid propellants and simpler operational systems will result in faster‑firing missiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical/engineering guidance favoring simpler, solid‑fuel designs to improve responsiveness and reduce launch complexity; presented as a path to quicker operational capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand SAC bomber force and heavy jet bombers / keep SAC at top efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand the Strategic Air Command bomber force, step up heavy jet bombers, and keep SAC at top efficiency while pursuing missile advances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy stance from senators and witnesses stressing that bomber forces must not be neglected amid the missile/satellite race; includes calls for funding and modernization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invest in submarine‑launched missiles (Polaris) and plan for quantity production
rubrics_metrics.description: Polaris developments represent a breakthrough; the Navy will request appropriations to build the first submarine capable of launching Polaris and later seek funds for quantity production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation to treat sea‑based deterrent (Polaris) as a high-priority program and to budget for transition from prototype to production and deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop an ICBM warning system as an urgent priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with utmost urgency to develop warning system components against intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs); currently there is 'no warning' capability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counsel from witnesses that warning/early‑detection capability is critical and that components exist but must be accelerated into an operational system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid administrative/monetary impediments and overtime restrictions that slow programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Address and remove administrative or monetary impediments (including overtime payment restrictions) that can bottleneck missile testing and production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Senators probed whether overtime limits and bureaucratic delays had slowed testing; witnesses urged eliminating such impediments to speed the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance production of rival systems (Thor vs. Jupiter) pragmatically
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess relative production merits pragmatically: Thor can be brought into greater production quicker, and it could be produced in quantity for substantially less cost than Jupiter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational/purchasing criterion: choose systems that balance performance, speed of production, and cost; testimony compared Thor and Jupiter on these grounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep decisionmaking streamlined — avoid excessive bureaucracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Speed decisionmaking in research, development and procurement to avoid long delays characteristic of U.S. programs compared to Soviet production speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Witnesses and senators emphasized that U.S. organizational complexity can lengthen development; streamlining and clearer authority were urged as ways to shorten timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control public information about sensitive space/missile tests for security
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain restrictions or blackouts on public information about certain missile and space tests where required for security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defense/public affairs officials argued for limited disclosure to avoid operational compromise, while acknowledging public interest; guidance framed as security vs. public information balance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize and plan for required manpower, bases, and modernization
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations on manpower levels, base locations, modernization and the number of ICBM squadrons should be reviewed and funded to meet strategic needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Senators asked whether recommended manpower, base, and modernization plans were being approved; planning and funding these elements were presented as necessary to achieve proposed force levels.
